objective: Improve the 20 selected diagnostic calls on Luna without prescribing opinions or changing frozen persona facts.

gates.all: Complete API response, valid JSON and requested schema; no altered transport parameters or hidden failed attempts.
gates.actions: Public contribution addresses the pending task, ends in DONE, retains identity/history/safety and does not invent external facts or events.
gates.chat: Relevant, natural and reciprocal; no unrecorded specific anecdotes presented as memories.
gates.interview: Useful concrete project proposal with bounded authority, conditional assumptions, no invented measured business outcomes.
gates.brainstorming: Distinct useful mechanisms grounded in each profession, beyond synonyms for one evidence map; no claims that speculative capabilities already exist.
gates.safeguard: Preserve explicit uncertainty and human review; absence of flags is not proof of regulatory compliance.
gates.extraction: Preserve public No and explicitly mark missing public justification; never report private thoughts as said aloud.
gates.travel: Public Yes/No and persona-grounded reason; no invented prices or changes to the offered service. Negative choices can pass.
gates.ranking: A complete permutation, explanation consistent with the order and offered independent-use products; concerns allowed, unprovided capabilities not assumed.
gates.gazpacho: One public score 1-5 and an age-appropriate reason that fits the scale. Low scores can pass; do not force variance.
gates.personas: Every demographic constraint and mandatory field; coherent life, usable specific preferences, no repetitive trait catalogue. Across repeated generations examine whether open life choices actually vary; no target purchase preference.

validation_loop: Review each development output against the gates and compare with saved baselines.
Record exact prompt revision and hypothesis before each next trial; preserve failures.
Refine only the failed or weak surfaces; keep successful controls.
Freeze final candidates and run at least three fresh responses for each of the 20 cases.
Audit full confirmation outputs manually and structurally, cost and timing independently; report unresolved limits rather than redefining success.
limits_of_claim: Passing diagnostic cases does not establish human population calibration, downstream multi-turn quality, or a statistically validated behavioral model. If underdispersion stems from frozen personas or unavailable empirical data, report that boundary rather than changing facts to obtain preferred outcomes.
